summary: TransDigm Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of TransDigm Group Incorporated, filed an 8-K reporting the completed offering of $3,000 million of new 6.75% Senior Secured Notes maturing January 2035 at an issue price of 100.00% of principal. Net proceeds will fund a concurrent tender offer launched September 14, 2026, to repurchase the Issuer's outstanding $2,100 million 6.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2028, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The notes are guaranteed on a senior secured basis by TransDigm Group and restricted subsidiaries. Watch for tender participation and take-up levels, potential proration, and any residual 2028 notes outstanding after the offer.
